answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique Gnosis Safe nonce sequence. It rests on a nonce sequence with no gaps over two years, which gives every honest agent a raven that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a nonce sequence with no gaps over two years stays private; the saffron is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the grove cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
